page.layout: One page of text, title block at top, body paragraph below. No margin notes. Ornamental rule above the title, not transcribed. Signature "A 2" at foot left, catchword "indu-" at foot right.

main_text.head: Viro admodum Reverendo ac clarissimo Domino JOHANNI MELLETO. Serenissimæ ac Celsissimæ Dominæ Principis Colignio-wirtembergicæ Concionatori fidelissimo, simulque Ecclesiæ Reformatæ Sanct Marianæ in Alsatia, pastori primario vigilantissimo, Domino fratri ac Symmystæ, in Christo plurimùm colendo,
main_text.p: Redit ad te, Vir admodum Reveren-de & Clarissime, quam jam ab aliquot annis a tua humanitate lætissi-mus impetravi THEOSOPHIA NATURALIS, cuius semina ante quinquennium præterpropter Basi-leæ publici iuris fieri voluere qui nos amant: Sed redit ad te, alio habitu indu-

page.notes: No printed page number or running head. Drop-cap R of "Redit" is joined to "Edit" as one word. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Ornamental rule and typographic flourishes not transcribed. The "Salutem à fonte Salutis!" line is set in italics and treated as a greeting paragraph. Small capitals in "THEOSOPHIA NATURALIS" are given in capitals.
